# vyos.blueprints.gre_tunnel

Tunnel interfaces (GRE and other encapsulations)

- Creates `interfaces tunnel` entries with their encapsulation, endpoints, MTU and TCP MSS clamping, and addresses them.
- Building block used by "Site-to-Site IPSec VPN to Cisco using FlexVPN" (GRE protected by IPsec); also usable for plain GRE.
- The tunnel itself is created with vyos.vyos.vyos_config in one commit, because vyos_interfaces cannot set encapsulation or endpoints; addresses use vyos_l3_interfaces.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.gre_tunnel
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces` | list | yes |  | Tunnel interfaces. |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | Interface name, e.g. `tun1`. |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.encapsulation` | str |  | `gre` | Encapsulation, e.g. `gre`, `gretap`, `ipip`. |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.source_address` | str |  |  | Local endpoint address. |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.source_interface` | str |  |  | Local endpoint interface (instead of `source_address`). |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.remote` | str |  |  | Remote endpoint address. Omit for multipoint GRE (DMVPN). |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.key` | int |  |  | GRE key (`parameters ip key`). |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.enable_multicast` | bool |  | `false` | Enable multicast on the tunnel (needed by NHRP/OSPF on mGRE). |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.mtu` | int |  |  | Interface MTU. |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.adjust_mss` | str |  |  | TCP MSS clamping value, e.g. `1336` or `clamp-mss-to-pmtu`. |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.description` | str |  |  | Interface description. |
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces.addresses` | list |  | `[]` | IPv4 addresses in CIDR notation. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every tunnel interface is up.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gre_tunnel_interfaces` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
